subject: Trial success roadmap and stakeholder roles
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@fintrak.io>, Michael Chen <m.chen@fintrak.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Trial success roadmap and stakeholder roles

Hi Sofia / Michael — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the proposed next steps so we can lock the trial kickoff this month. I’ve attached a draft trial plan (spreadsheet) and a short checklist.

Goal
- Run a 4-week production-like trial to validate latency, cost per token under your estimated traffic profile, and end-to-end integration with FinTrak auth and data flows.

Success criteria (proposed)
- Average 95th-percentile inference latency <= 400ms for typical 512-token requests (non-batched).
- End-to-end request success rate >= 99.5% over a rolling 24h window.
- Embedding similarity recall: baseline compare to your existing reranker shows >= 3% uplift on the P0 prompt set.
- No high-severity security blockers (access control, data-at-rest encryption) identified during the trial.

High-level trial plan (attached: fintrak_trial_plan_draft.xlsx)
- Week 0: Kickoff, infra access, test corpus ingestion, baseline metrics collected.
- Weeks 1–3: Run live sampling (shadow) then controlled traffic; apply batching and caching configs.
- Week 4: Final evaluation, cost analysis, and recommendation.

Owners (we need your confirmation)
- App owner: who on FinTrak owns the integration code/deployments?
- Infra/Cloud owner: who will provide temporary access to the VPC/cloud account or confirm Dedicated capacity?
- Security owner: SOC/compliance contact to review questionnaire and sign off on required controls.
- Procurement: who is the procurement contact for any POC agreement / purchase order?

Ask from you today
1) Confirm the FinTrak owner names/emails for App / Infra / Security / Procurement so we can create a RACI and share the kickoff invite.
2) Approve the success criteria above or flag any changes.
3) Confirm target kickoff week (we have availability starting Mar 22).

Attachments: fintrak_trial_plan_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones and test corpus), security_questionnaire_responses.pdf (pre-filled questions we can iterate on).

I’ll loop Marissa (solutions) and Monica (acct. lead) for technical and contract coordination.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0198

Subject: Re: Trial success roadmap and stakeholder roles

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary and for putting the draft together. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side: 

Owners (FinTrak)
- App owner: Michael Chen (m.chen@fintrak.io) — I’ll own integration and deploys.
- Infra/Cloud owner: Marcus Li (marcus.li@fintrak.io) — he’ll provision sandbox VPC access and temporary keys.
- Security owner: Priya Natarajan (priya.n@fintrak.io) — SOC/compliance lead; she prefers to see the questionnaire before kickoff.
- Procurement: Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@fintrak.io) — procurement and PO approvals.

Success criteria notes
- Latency target sounds reasonable but can we set 95th <= 450ms as an initial threshold and aim to optimize to 400ms during the run?
- For embeddings uplift — we’ll provide a labeled 1k sample set for A/B. If you can run the reranker comparison, that’d be great.

Timelines
- Mar 22 kickoff looks good for FinTrak. We’ll aim to have Marcus and Priya available for the first-day alignment.

I’ve attached the list of their emails above — will loop Marcus and Priya separately if you want a short intro.

On the questionnaire, Priya asked if you can fill the initial responses and flag items that will need evidence or follow-ups.

Thanks — Mike

Hi all — quick tech notes from my side ahead of kickoff: 

1) Test corpus ingestion: please share an S3/GCS path or a Drive folder with the 1k labeled sample and any synthetic traffic patterns you want us to mirror. We can accept csv/json lines.
2) VPC access: Marcus — when you provision the sandbox, please add redwood-poc@redwood.inference as a service account and open ports 443 and 22 for the jump host. We will not store raw customer data outside of the agreed bucket.
3) Baseline capture: we’ll run a short traffic replay for 24h to capture baseline p95 and costs. Can you confirm the representative timeframe (e.g., business hours vs 24x7)?

Drive folder with the draft test harness and scripts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bTrialDocs (view-only for now). I put a checklist and a small runbook (runbook.md) in there.

I’ll prepare an infra checklist and a short RACI table that maps our tasks to the FinTrak owners you provided. Attaching a stub: security_questionnaire_responses.pdf (initial responses) and fintrak_trial_plan_draft.xlsx updated with Mar 22 kickoff.

Marissa
